neighbours.label: the part that must fit inside something else: your foot in a shoe, a card in a slot, a key in a lock (a guess)
fire: Choose boots that feel right, so that your foot sits snugly inside them.
Stand up in the shoes and check how your foot moves inside them.
Put the glove on and see whether your hand fits inside it comfortably.
Measure your head before buying so that the helmet fits properly.
The key should go in the lock without any force.
Will the card fit in the slot on the board?
Make sure the lid sits on the jar before you shake it.
The drawer must fit inside the cabinet, so measure it twice.
quiet: Choose boots that look nice, so that your friends will admire them.
Stand up in the boat and check how the water moves around it.
Hold the rope tight and see whether the horse walks beside you calmly.
Measure your budget before buying so that the helmet stays affordable.
The thief should leave the house without any noise.
Will the card arrive in the mail by the end of the week?
Make sure the dog sits on the mat before you feed him.
The drawer must be painted white, so buy more paint.

notes: The card's output direction promotes ' fits', ' fitting', ' fit', ' within', ' onto', and one top example is ' foot' inside shoes, but probes stayed under 0.31, so a failure is likely.
